sqlite.name: station_location_precision
sqlite.sql:
CREATE TABLE station_location_precision (
	station_id VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL, 
	precision_m INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	basis VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, 
	note VARCHAR(300), 
	updated_by INTEGER, 
	updated_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (station_id), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_station_location_precision_range CHECK (precision_m >= 1 AND precision_m <= 100000), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_station_location_precision_basis CHECK (basis IN ('surveyed','owner_confirmed','estimated')), 
	FOREIGN KEY(station_id) REFERENCES stations (station_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(updated_by) REFERENCES users (id)
)

postgresql.name: station_location_precision
